Subject: Siemco Azure co-sell — initial runbook & proposed slots

Hi Anna / Mark,

Thanks again for agreeing to the customer-facing co-sell demo next week. We pulled together a short runbook and a proposed two-hour window to cover: context, live demo (Redwood on Azure), partner integration touchpoints, and Q&A.

Proposed windows (all CET):
- Tue, 25 May 2027 — 10:00–12:00 CET
- Wed, 26 May 2027 — 14:00–16:00 CET

Quick asks:
- Please confirm availability for either slot or suggest a 30-min buffer earlier/later if you need to include additional stakeholders.
- See attached "Siemco-Rollforward-Agenda.pdf" and a lightweight runbook at the Drive link below.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3Siemco-demo

If neither works, we can roll forward to the following week; wanted to lock this first so engineering can reserve time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez

Diego: +1 (415) 555-0198

Diego — thanks for the agenda and the runbook. Both look good. A couple of notes from our side:
- Our CISO wants a quick 15-min security call immediately before the demo (they prefer a short safety intro).
- The proposed Tue 10:00–12:00 CET is tight for a few of our EU field reps; Wed 14:00–16:00 CET looks better.

Can we move to Wed 26th 14:00–16:30 CET to give the security intro and a 15-min wrap? If AWS needs to join earlier we can nudge to 13:45 CET.

Also looping in Mark from AWS to confirm their readiness for the integration segment.

Thanks — Anna

Anna — that works. Thanks for flagging the CISO ask. Proposed updated timeline (all CET):
- 13:45 — AWS brief join (warm handoff)
- 14:00 — Security intro (15 min)
- 14:15 — Live demo (60–75 min)
- 15:30 — Integration deep-dive with AWS (20 min)
- 15:50 — Buffer + wrap (20 min)

That gets us to 16:10; I added a 20-min wrap to make sure we close action items. We'll publish a slim runbook that includes the security checklist and an attendee list.

Two operational notes:
1) Vanessa — can you own the run-of-show and be our Zoom host? I will send the rehearsal invite with the deck.
2) Karthik / Soojin — please review the runbook checklist (attached) and flag any infra/latency notes — we expect to show a mixed-cloud route: hosted Redwood on Azure with a fallback to Dedicated in case of perf issues.

Attachments: runbook-demo-checklist.md
Runbook (draft) link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3Siemco-demo

If anyone needs a further time buffer, we can roll to the week of 31 May — but engineering prefers one rehearsal this week.

Best,
Diego

- 14:00 — Security intro (Anna's CISO) — 15 min
- 14:15 — Live demo (Redwood on Azure) — 60 min
- 15:15 — Integration QA with AWS — 30 min

- Vanessa: Host + manage recording / breakout if we need private partner syncs
- Diego: Final deck + attendee list (by Mon 31 May EOD CET)
